name: Çıkış — oturum kapatınca giriş ekranına dönülür

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://soncagstock.vercel.app/ and log in with the project's configured username and password (click 'Giriş Yap'), wait until the header text 'Sonçağ Stok · Dashboard' is visible
Click the logout icon button inside the user widget in the header
A toast with the text 'Çıkış yapıldı' appears
The login card with the subtitle 'Hesabınla giriş yap' is visible again and both email and password inputs are empty
The header text 'Sonçağ Stok · Dashboard' and the 'Toplam Ürün' stat card are no longer visible
The login screen is still shown (session was cleared); the dashboard does not auto-open
